sections.overview: This small mochokid catfish is native to Lake Tanganyika, where it is endemic to the lake basin.
sections.identification: Its spotted pattern varies considerably, so spot size and spacing alone are not reliable identifiers.
sections.habitat: It is recorded from the rocky littoral of Lake Tanganyika.
sections.diet: Studies summarized in a taxonomic revision report algae and small invertebrates in adult diets; juveniles feed mainly on tiny invertebrates.
sections.behavior: The taxonomic revision summarizes feeding observations but provides little broader behavioral detail for this species.
sections.reproduction: The 2006 taxonomic revision found no published account of this species’ spawning behavior.
sections.ecology: The adjacent catalogue entry for Synodontis grandiops needs a taxonomic caveat: a 2024 revision treats that name as a junior synonym of S. multipunctatus, while retaining S. petricola as distinct.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN category of Least Concern for this species.
